svg.title: Inside Inkling 2 Mini
svg.desc: Four stacks of six layers share a base. The first runs once. The middle two light up three times, exchanging a message between passes while the first block's output remains available. After the third pass, the last stack runs and the model predicts a token.
svg.text: 6 input layers + (12 middle layers × 3 passes) + 6 output layers
